name: Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
benefit: **Scholarship for purchase of books and notebooks:** - Scholarship for students studying from 1st to 5th standard: ₹1,000/- per annum. - Scholarship for students studying from 6th to 8th standard: ₹3,000/- per annum.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary must be a student. 
1. The beneficiary must be a differently abled person. 
1. The beneficiary must be studying in between class 1st to 8th standard. 
1. The beneficiary must be studying in government-recognized schools. 
1. The beneficiary must be student should not be avail of similar assistance from other sources.
